pages.text: $(l)Sandrone's Doll$() is a massive juggernaut and a masterpiece of engineering, capable of absorbing immense damage while crushing enemies.

pages.title: Unit Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 100$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 10$(li)$(4)Melee Damage:$() 7.5$(br2)Its massive health pool allows it to stand its ground against powerful bosses. You can heal it by equipping food to it.

pages.title: Homing Projectiles
pages.text: Every $(6)15 seconds$(), the doll creates homing projectiles that track down and strike nearby enemies.
Requires premium materials. Sandrone is back; Toymaker has the plans to make the tiny Pulonia, if only they could do it from the beginning.
